content:
We Are NOT Family 😭

One day, an employee told me:
My manager wants to terminate me.”

I asked, “But he always says, ‘We are family.’ ❤️”

He replied, “How can family terminate family?” 😭

I smiled and said:

“Because you are a team, not a family.”

Think about cricket. 🏏

A team has 11 players, each with a role.

If one player consistently doesn’t perform, even after support and feedback, they may be replaced.

Not out of hatred.

Because the team has to win.

At work too:

Support people.
Respect people.
But hold them accountable.

We are a team, not a family.

Agree?
